from collections import Counter
# find each non-background color bounding rects and fill interior; background test dominant 6
import copy
out=copy.deepcopy(grid)
for color in set(sum(grid,[]))-{6}:
 pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
 if not pts: continue
 r0=min(r for r,c in pts);r1=max(r for r,c in pts);c0=min(c for r,c in pts);c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
 # solid rectangular outline validation
 if all(grid[r][c]==color for r in (r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r][c]==color for c in (c0,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
  interior=(r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1); fill=7 if interior<=12 else 2
  for r in range(r0+1,r1):
   for c in range(c0+1,c1): out[r][c]=fill
print(out)
